note: Questions are written in plain words, as a person would ask. `expected` lists the section numbers that count as a correct citation (any one is a hit). `evidence` are phrases that must appear in the expected sections' text, so `python eval_ground.py --verify-labels --text <the real text>` fails loudly on a wrong label. Labels were written from the 2013 text and have NOT yet been verified against the real file: run --verify-labels once with the operator-supplied text before trusting a score. Amendments since 2013 (No. 1 of 2017, No. 2 of 2021) and the 2026 Bill are not in the 2013 text; questions avoid the provisions they changed.
